issues.evidence: The Tibetan has only རྟག་པར་མངོན་ཞེན་གྱིས་བསླང་བ (motivated constantly / by strong inclination, mngon zhen; Skt sātatyābhiniveśa). bo-kunpal 5-81 glosses མངོན་ཞེན as འདུན་པ་ཤུགས་དྲག་པོ (strong aspiration); nothing corresponds to 'fixed'.

མཚུངས་པར་གུས་པས་ཀུན་དུ་སྤྱད has ཀུན་དུ་སྤྱད 'engage in / treat fully' (Skt samaṃ gauravam ācaret); there is no word for 'always' (རྟག་ཏུ). bo-gyaltsab 5-89 glosses it ཀུན་ལ་མཚུངས་པར་གུས་པས་ཀུན་ཏུ་སྤྱད་ཅིང་ཉམས་སུ་བླང་བར་བྱའོ, with no temporal 'always'.
issues.fix: One should treat with equal respect

issues.span: until one is able to practice it all
issues.evidence: The Tibetan says only དེ་སྲིད་ 'for that long / so long' with no stated end-point. The commentaries differ: bo-gyaltsab 5-97 reads ངེས་པར་སྤྱོད་པ་མཐའ་དག་ཉམས་སུ་ལེན་ནུས་པ་དེ་སྲིད་ (until able to practise all), while bo-kunpal 5-97 reads སེམས་སྦྱོང་མ་ཐུབ་པར་དེ་སྲིད་དུ (so long as the mind has not been trained). The English commits to one commentary's reading.
issues.fix: One should certainly practice the conduct of purifying the mind for that long.

issues.span: earnestly regarding patience, One should practice meditation in various ways
issues.evidence: བཟོད་ལ་ནན་ཏན་དུ། སྣ་ཚོགས་ཚུལ་དུ་བསྒོམ་པར་བྱ: བཟོད་ལ་ is the object of བསྒོམ ('meditate on / cultivate patience', Skt kṣāntiṃ bhāvayet; bo-gyaltsab 6-2 བཟོད་པ་བསྒོམ་པ་ལ་ནན་ཏན་དུ). 'Regarding patience, practice meditation' loosens the object relation and is awkward.
issues.fix: Therefore one should earnestly cultivate meditation on patience in various ways.
